chunks: Say: "If I am in error it is to my own loss; if I am on guidance that is so because of what my Lord reveals to me. He is all-hearing and all-too-near."
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'If I err, it is to my own loss' in Surah Saba?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Prophet's (SAWW) infallibility (Ismah) by distinguishing between his personal human nature and the divine source of his guidance, affirming that his success is solely due to Wahy. It highlights the intimate relationship between the Creator and the created, reinforcing the concept that true guidance is a divine gift rather than human effort alone. This serves as a model for the Imams, who similarly rely on divine inspiration while maintaining their human humility.
